en: A color postcard featuring a bronze statue of a woman standing in front of an old stone building with arched entrance and decorative facade. Around the statue, several illustrated bags and suitcases are shown, each labeled with local attractions such as 'Marikenstraat', 'Waalkade', 'Museum Valkhof', 'MuZIEum' and 'LUX'. Along the right border, vertically, is the greeting text 'Groeten uit Nijmegen'.
